Broadcom (AVGO) vs Intel (INTC): on the same formula, their operating margins are 44.1 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AVGO: $63.9B · INTC: $52.9B
• Revenue growth — AVGO: +23.9% · INTC: −0.5%
• Operating margin — AVGO: 39.9% · INTC: −4.2%
• Net margin — AVGO: 36.2% · INTC: −0.5%
• Free cash flow margin — AVGO: 42.1% · INTC: −9.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AVGO: 23.5% · INTC: −9.6%

Different fiscal years: AVGO Nov 2, 2025 · INTC Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
